title: Hải đăng tắt
about: Round x5 of the dark ambient style (khong-gian), as the user asked ("hãy sáng tác thêm cho tôi nhiều bài nữa"): a lighthouse gone dark: wind off the sea, a deep bell like a fog signal on every chord, the glass far out singing a few notes. A minor at 46 bpm. An original piece.
